steps.label: Core board
steps.body: Every enclosure starts with the same board, with authentication, actuation, and a year of battery life built in.

steps.label: Environment board
steps.body: Stack the environment board and it holds 2–8°C for eight hours, logging temperature alongside every custody event.

steps.label: Connectivity board
steps.body: Add the connectivity board for 1 km of LoRa and Bluetooth reach, with no Wi-Fi, no SIM, and no dependency on the site.
